vendor: Invideo (Whitesheep Technology Private Limited, India; Invideo Innovation Pte. Ltd., Singapore)
product_family: AI video creation platform: Invideo AI / Agent One (agentic AI video generation), Invideo Studio (online video editor), Talking Avatar by Videocreek, plus Team & Enterprise tiers

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center overview (verbatim): 'This portal provides real-time access to our latest security certifications, compliance reports, and legal documentation (including SOC 2 and GDPR).' The vendor's own trust center thus names SOC 2 as a report it holds, but the report sits behind 'Request access' and could not be independently retrieved; the public homepage hedges the posture as 'SOC 2 & ISO Aligned' rather than 'SOC 2 certified'. Held kept as 'unknown' (a SOC 2 report is plausibly held but the gated report and audit period/type could not be verified); no public copy was found via web search.
certifications.source: https://trust.invideo.io/ (overview text) and https://invideo.io/ ('SOC 2 & ISO Aligned')

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: The homepage badge reads (verbatim): 'Private & Secure / SOC 2 & ISO Aligned / GDPR Compliant.' 'Aligned' denotes following the framework's controls, not holding an accredited certificate (a certified vendor would state 'ISO 27001 certified'). The trust center, when enumerating the reports it makes available, names only 'SOC 2 and GDPR' and does not reference any ISO 27001 certificate, and no ISO certificate appears in the public control list. No published ISO 27001 certificate for Invideo was found.
certifications.source: https://invideo.io/ ('SOC 2 & ISO Aligned') and https://trust.invideo.io/ (reports list names SOC 2 + GDPR, no ISO)

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR Compliant — homepage trust badge; Privacy Policy enumerates Data Subject rights (access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, complaint to a supervisory authority) and lawful bases of processing.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of HIPAA anywhere on the trust center, security pages, or privacy policy; service is consumer/creator video tooling, not health data.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Payments are handled by Stripe (listed subprocessor: 'Stripe • Finance and payments'); no direct PCI claim by Invideo.

privacy.ai_training_note: Two distinct regimes. ENTERPRISE (MSA-based) privacy policy: 'Such processing supports Service functionality and does not use Customer Personal Data to train general models for other customers, except as expressly permitted or using aggregated/de-identified data.' CONSUMER terms are broader: 'We may also use Customer Content/ Output generated using your Customer Content for the purpose of supporting and developing and further improving the Services' and grant Invideo an 'irrevocable, perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free' license; this content/improvement license explicitly 'do not apply to enterprise customers.' Biometric face data for avatars is 'never shared, sold, or disclosed,' processed on Invideo's own AI model, and 'immediately and permanently deleted' on avatar/account deletion. No model-training opt-out is documented for consumer users.
privacy.data_region: Hosted on AWS; international transfers explicitly contemplated. Controllers are an Indian entity (Whitesheep Technology Pvt Ltd) and a Singapore entity (Invideo Innovation Pte Ltd). No customer-selectable data residency advertised.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Stated — 'Data transmission encrypted' control listed under Product security.

security.name: Encryption / key management
security.value: Stated — 'Encryption key access restricted' and 'Unique production database authentication enforced' under Infrastructure security.

security.name: Vulnerability monitoring
security.value: Stated — 'Vulnerability and system monitoring procedures established' under Product security.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: unknown — not explicitly named in the public (ungated) control list; full control set and audit reports are behind 'Request access.'

security.name: Bug bounty / vulnerability disclosure
security.value: No public HackerOne or Bugcrowd program found. Security contact is security@invideo.io. (An internal/in-house bounty effort has been referenced historically by an Invideo engineer, but no public program.)

security.name: Org security controls
security.value: Stated — 'Employee background checks performed', 'Anti-malware technology utilized', 'Production inventory maintained'.

security.name: Business continuity / DR
security.value: Stated — 'Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans established' and 'tested'.

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: Disclosed: Amazon Web Services (cloud), Stripe (payments), OpenAI (data storage/processing), Anthropic (data storage/processing).

security.name: Trust center platform
security.value: Hosted, gated trust portal (Vanta-style) with live control list; full reports require requesting access.

products.name: Invideo AI / Agent One (Individual: Plus, Max, Generative, Elite)
products.data_scope: Personal account data, prompts, uploaded Customer Content, generated Output, device/usage analytics, optional biometric face data for avatars. Routes prompts/content to third-party model subprocessors (OpenAI, Anthropic) and 200+ generation models.
products.notes: Governed by consumer Terms + consumer Privacy Policy. Broad perpetual content license; content/Output may be used to 'develop and improve the Services.' No documented training opt-out for consumers.

products.name: Invideo Studio
products.data_scope: Account, uploaded media, usage data; same consumer privacy regime.
products.notes: Bundled under the same 'Services' umbrella and consumer policies.

products.name: Talking Avatar by Videocreek
products.data_scope: Facial coordinate (biometric) data from face scans; stored on Invideo servers, not shared with third parties, deleted on avatar/account deletion.
products.notes: May constitute biometric identifiers under applicable privacy laws (e.g., BIPA-type). Custom Avatar creation requires explicit recorded consent.

products.name: Team & Enterprise
products.category: Business/enterprise AI video with collaboration (multiplayer, custom agents)
products.data_scope: Governed by a separate MSA, DPA, and the enterprise Privacy Policy. Customer Data/Content processed as a processor under the DPA.
products.notes: Materially stronger contractual posture: consumer broad-license terms do NOT apply; vendor states it does not use Customer Personal Data to train general models for other customers.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription, credit-based. Individual: Plus $17/mo, Max $85/mo, Generative $170/mo, Elite $900/mo (billed annually); plus Team & Enterprise tier and on-demand credit top-ups. Free tier with limited functionality.
compare.data_residency: No customer-selectable residency; AWS-hosted with international transfers; India + Singapore legal entities.

flags: SOC 2 status is ambiguous: trust center says it provides access to 'compliance reports... including SOC 2' but the public homepage hedges as 'SOC 2 & ISO Aligned' (aligned != certified). Actual SOC 2 report is behind 'Request access' and could not be directly verified.
No public bug bounty (HackerOne/Bugcrowd); pentest not explicitly confirmed in ungated controls.

Consumer Terms grant a broad, perpetual, irrevocable license over Customer Content/Output and allow use to 'develop and improve the Services'; no consumer training opt-out. Enterprise carve-out is much stronger.
Biometric (face) data processing for avatars, relevant for jurisdictions with biometric privacy laws.
Subprocessors include OpenAI and Anthropic for data storage/processing, so prompts/content leave Invideo's infrastructure.
